versions.changelog:
## Farmers Advancements 1.0

First release.

- A new advancement tab, Farmer's Almanac, with 30 advancements about farming.
- Planting: wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, pumpkins, melons, sweet berries, nether wart, torchflowers and pitcher pods.
- Harvesting, animals, farm food and farm tools, from a full stack of wheat to breeding cows, sheep, pigs, chickens and rabbits.
- Three challenges: collect every crop, breed every farm animal and eat a full harvest feast.
- Some advancements give experience. None give items.

## Farmers Advancements 1.1

Now also for Minecraft 26.3.

- The same zip works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3: the advancements are included in the format each version reads.
- Same 30 advancements and the same rewards on every version, nothing changes on 1.21 and 1.21.1.

## Farmers Advancements 1.2

15 new advancements about animals.

- Breed mooshrooms, goats, bees, armadillos, horses, donkeys, llamas and camels.
- Tame a donkey and a llama.
- Animal care: feed wheat to a calf, shear a sheep, milk a goat and fill a bowl with mooshroom stew.
- A new challenge, Wide Open Range: breed all eight of the new animals.
- The Farmer's Almanac tab now has 45 advancements. Some of the new ones give experience, none give items.
- Works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3 as before; the first 30 advancements are unchanged.
